model_annotation: The chart is a horizontal stacked bar chart illustrating government expenditures as a percentage of GDP for multiple European countries, showing the 2021 level and the increase between 2021 and 2024, with an additional reference marker indicating “1,5 % über dem Referenzwert von 2021.” The category axis is the vertical axis listing countries from top to bottom (Polen, Estland, Lettland, Litauen, Finnland, Dänemark, Rumänien, Bulgarien, Schweden, Deutschland, Ungarn, Tschechien, Frankreich, Niederlande, Slowakei, Portugal, Italien, Belgien, Slowenien, Luxemburg, Spanien), and the value axis is the horizontal axis labeled “% des BIP,” shown on a linear scale with labeled ticks at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4. Each country has a stacked bar composed of a light-green segment labeled “Ausgaben 2021” and a dark-blue segment labeled “Anstieg zwischen 2021 und 2024,” with the blue segment forming the left portion from zero and the green segment stacked to the right to extend the total length; for example, Polen’s bar extends a little past 4 (approximately 4.1) with a blue portion around 2.2 and a green portion around 1.9, Estland totals around 3.4 (blue about 2.0, green about 1.4), Lettland totals around 3.1 (blue about 2.1, green about 1.0), and Litauen totals around 2.8 (blue about 2.0, green about 0.8). Mid-range totals include Finnland around 2.4 (blue about 1.4, green about 1.0), Dänemark around 2.4 (blue about 1.3, green about 1.1), and several countries near 2.0–2.2 such as Rumänien (~2.2), Bulgarien (~2.2), Schweden (~2.2), Deutschland (~2.1), Ungarn (~2.0), Tschechien (~2.0), Frankreich (~2.0), Niederlande (~2.0), and Slowakei (~2.0), each with varying blue and green splits visible within the stack. Shorter totals appear for Portugal (~1.6), Italien (~1.5), Belgien (~1.3), Slowenien (~1.3), Luxemburg (~1.3), and Spanien (~1.2), with Luxemburg showing a notably small blue segment (around 0.4) and a larger green segment (around 0.9) compared with its total. Black vertical tick-like markers (one per country row) appear to the right of the stacked bars at varying x-positions (roughly between about 2.0 and 3.6), corresponding to the legend entry “1,5 % über dem Referenzwert von 2021.” The countries appear ordered from larger total stacked values at the top to smaller totals toward the bottom, and no bars are otherwise specially outlined or annotated beyond the color legend and the black reference markers.
